parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time in UTC, in ISO 8601 format. If you omit this parameter, the current time is used.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: The sort order of returned metrics. Valid values: ASC or DESC.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of items per page.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time in UTC, in ISO 8601 format. If you omit this parameter, the task start time is used.

parameters.name: TrainingJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the training task.
